description: Supersede an existing entry with a revised one (supersession, not mutation). Creates a NEW entry carrying metadata.supersedes=<target_id> and marks the target with superseded_by and superseded_at. The old entry stays readable: it is not hidden and is_live is not cleared. Recall, query_layer and semantic_recall return it marked with that end date and the id of the new entry. The current entry is listed first. Episodic revision is prohibited - events are immutable.

content.description: Full revised content - must stand alone without the superseded entry

exchange.description: The exchange (turn) this write belongs to, counting from 1. A write for exchange n while exchange n-1 was never appended is refused by the session graph until n-1 is appended.

layer.description: Layer of the entry being revised (episodic is prohibited)

metadata.description: Metadata for the new entry (supersedes is set automatically; include source tag)

session_id.description: Your transcript session id from emet_session_open. The session graph reads this session's state before the write and returns `session_graph.next` - the next step. A governed write with no session is refused (open one with emet_session_open and load_id).

target_id.description: ID of the entry this revision supersedes

name: revise_memory
